notes.title: Closed Beta testers wanted!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Volseons is currently searching for some talented closed beta testers in order to get some early feedback about the Prologue.

 How do sign up for that? 

It's easy: enter through our Google Form here:
 Closed Beta Testers Form	

We are eager to get in touch and let the testing begin!

Thank you so much for helping us with the testing/feedback part and have a wonderful day!
